messages:
devon: Heads-up: discovered ~1.1k embed events attributed to customer 'alpha-retail' that actually belong to 'beta-analytics' due to header rewrite during regional merge. Invoice INV-21089 may be overbilled. Tagging finance. @oliver @nisha

metering-bot: ALERT: attribution-anomaly | window=2026-09-09T22:00:00Z..2026-09-09T22:30:00Z | misattributed_events=1109 | confidence=0.95

nisha: Quick check: ran a join between ingest.raw and billing.attribution. Found rows where original_customer_id != billing_customer_id and aggregator_node='us-east-merge-3'. Sample: req_9a7c, req_b2f1, req_d03e. Looks like X-Customer-ID header overwritten during batch-merge.

oliver: That's bad. Two immediate problems: (A) customer-facing billing accuracy for alpha-retail (they were billed for events that weren't theirs) and (B) potential cross-account data exposure if payloads were visible after misattribution. We should loop in security & legal.

finance-bot: ACTION_REQUIRED: create_recon_ticket | invoice=INV-21089 | suspected_overcharge=1109 embeds | est_credit=1109 * $0.17 = $188.53 | status=pending

devon: From a remediation POV ops suggests: (1) run backfill to correct billing_customer_id for those events so invoice can be recomputed, (2) patch merge service to preserve original header, (3) produce reconciled report for both customers. Ops ETA 3-5 hours for backfill + verification.

emily-cs: CS requests provisional credit be applied to alpha-retail immediately to prevent escalation. They also want clear copy to send: "We're investigating a routing issue that affected a subset of events; a provisional credit has been applied while we reconcile."

nisha: Two accounting paths: A) Issue provisional credit to alpha-retail and after backfill re-calc invoice; if alpha actually owes money, bill them on next invoice. B) If we can correct attribution and re-emit invoice before closing period, adjust directly. Practicality: invoice close already processed for INV-21089. So we'll need a credit entry.

finance-bot: RECOMMENDATION: provisional_credit $190 to alpha-retail, tag ledger with reason="misattributed embeds - provisional". Post-backfill, attach reconciled diff and finalize adjustment.

oliver: Also opening legal ticket LG-778: potential cross-account exposure review. Notifying security.

devon: I'll start targeted backfill now (job id backfill-3190). Will log rows corrected and attach diff CSV. ETA ~4h.

emily-cs: I've drafted customer note and queued it pending confirmation that provisional credit applied. Please cc me on billing_journal so CS can follow up.

finance-bot: ACTION: create_provisional_credit | invoice=INV-21089 | amt=190.00 | reason="provisional credit for misattributed embeds" | status=created

emily-cs: Thanks team. Alpha-retail notified: "A provisional credit has been applied while we investigate. We will follow up with a detailed reconciliation." :thumbsup:

nisha: Backfill started job backfill-3190 at 2026-09-09T23:05:12Z. Will update when done with final reconciled numbers.

devon: Keeping thread updated. Finance: once backfill finishes please wait for reconciled diff before finalizing ledger adjustment.

oliver: Security/Legal looped in. Tracking remediation and communications.
